messages:
priya: Opening a docs PR to consolidate metering + rate-tier examples into one quick-start bundle. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4567 - will include a small SDK snippet and a dashboard panel screenshot. PTAL from billing and SDK folks.

devon: nice, mind calling out the burst behaviour example? customers keep getting tripped by that edge case.

priya: yes — adding a dedicated section titled 'Burst credits and consistent throughput' with example JSON and expected meter events.

marie: can you add the snippet for the python sdk v2? common footgun is missing the headers for quota attribution. sample:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("RW_KEY"))
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-mini", prompt="hi", headers={"X-Customer-ID":"acct_123"})
```

priya: perfect, i'll include that. also adding note about SDK header backward compatibility with older integrations.

aland: FYI billing-bot will flag any docs that reference exact numeric tier names. we should use the canonical tier slugs (pro/enterprise) not internal labels.

priya: good call, switching all examples to slugs. also adding a short migration note for teams that used 'tier_v1' labels.

devon: for the dashboard image — can you export the panel with anonymized IDs? QA previously caught a live project id in a screenshot.

priya: yes will sanitize. attaching the panel export in the PR comment instead of embedding raw JSON.

marie: quick question — do we want to show a meter example for embeddings (per-embed unit) and generation (per-token) in a single table? might confuse readers.

priya: thinking of a two-row example with clear unit columns and a short explanation that rates are orthogonal. simple table + callout should be fine.

docs-qa: i'll run a quick linter job on the PR: docs-lint + images-scan. will post results here.

billing-bot: Automated check: pricing references OK. Please confirm you have no explicit $/token numbers.

priya: confirmed — no raw $ numbers, only relative examples and links to pricing page.

devon: heads up — include a short snippet for the new quota headers for routed requests. sample curl would help ops folks.

priya: adding curl example: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -H "X-Quota-Route: pro" https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/generate`

marie: small nit — add a warning about header order when using proxies (headers might be stripped).

priya: noted, adding a troubleshooting section. thanks all — hoping to merge by EOD tomorrow after the linter runs. :thumbsup:
